hardware: Apple M2 Max, 32 GiB unified RAM
method: Separate processes, one full checkpoint each; real model weights, no synthetic weight matrices. Two Ministral processes per size, three Voxtral processes per loader. First decode per process excluded from warm statistics. Sampling 0.5 seconds plus collection overhead. No builds/tests during measured runs.
limits: RSS and getrusage MaxRSS are process residency counters, not complete accounting of all unified GPU/driver memory. HeapAlloc is Go heap only.
VM counters are system-wide and cannot be attributed exclusively to the benchmark process. Pageins include mapped weight loading; resident swap occupancy alone is not active paging.
No cache purge, background applications/thermal state uncontrolled; these are load and first-decode observations, not cold-SSD guarantees.
Ministral: full autoregressive chat, 27 prompt tokens, 64 output tokens, seed41, temperature0, default repeat penalty1.1, prefault core. Warm requests reuse complete prompt and its boundary logits.

Voxtral: full loaded model including prepared encoder, full Metal decoder; 32 teacher-forced token embeddings then 64 fixed embedding inputs with complete vocabulary selection. No audio encoding in timing, no transcript/recognition-quality or end-to-end STT rate claim.
All repeated token digests agree per Ministral model and across both Voxtral loaders. No proven Ministral decode speedup from this change.
Short-context decoder runs do not establish long-context throughput; Voxtral audio encoding can allocate additional workspace beyond the measured decoder workload.

post_measurement_review.description: Measured source hashes and raw results are retained. After measurement, partial loader layers were made reachable for error cleanup, and the harness gained failure cleanup and length checks. Successful inference and tensor allocations are unchanged. The patch maps measured sources to reviewed sources.
